description:
Markup written as a statement in a logic body that no `lift` names and that is not the single element of an `if` / `given` branch is E-MARKUP-STATEMENT-NOT-RENDERED — one per unrendered element: a bare `${

…

}`, two elements in one arm (2), an element after a statement, a `for` body without `lift`. Before S464 every one compiled at exit 0 and rendered nothing.
rationale: §17.6.10.1: "A markup element in statement position in a logic body that no `lift` names and that is not the single-element branch of a value-form (this section) SHALL be a compile error, E-MARKUP-STATEMENT-NOT-RENDERED." Ruling S462 Q24 "a"; code S464.
